title: Resisting Stochastic Risks in Diffusion Planners with the Trajectory Aggregation Tree

layout.note: Two stacked bands separated by a grey dashed line: (a) the diffusion pipeline above, (b) the TAT pipeline below, each unrolled over three aligned columns that end in an ellipsis.
